constraints: Pre-registered thresholds must not move after seeing results
Probe must remain read-only — re-verified by mtime+size hash after adding the sqlite open
context: Probe v2/v3: excluded archive-loop junk, then fixed live-board source after Dave caught the instrument reporting zero warnings a dashboard was showing
rationale: on a sqlite backend the JSONL is a pre-migration leftover that stops tracking the database, so the probe was measuring a board that had not existed for months; verified on the dogfood store where the stale file claimed 3 warnings and 162 statuses while the database held 15 warnings, 6 needs and zero statuses
summary: Chose to read the live board from twining.db directly (read-only open) with fallback order db -> records/posts -> blackboard.jsonl, replacing the v1/v2 order that preferred blackboard.jsonl whenever it was non-empty
